headline: A 40-acre Brigade township at the Whitefield end of the metro.
pitch: Brigade Granada is on the Whitefield to Kadugodi Road, in East Bengaluru. It is a large township from one of the city's most established builders, close to the Purple Line's last stations.

reasons.title: The metro is already running
reasons.text: The Purple Line reaches Whitefield (Kadugodi). The Whitefield end opened on 26 March 2023, and the line runs 43.49 km across the city.
reasons.source: Wikipedia (Namma Metro line pages), read 26 Nov 2026

reasons.title: It meets the airport line
reasons.text: The Purple Line interchanges with the Blue Line at KR Pura. Blue Line trial runs began in November 2026.

reasons.title: One of the city's biggest job hubs
reasons.text: Whitefield is home to ITPL and a long line of tech parks. Demand here comes from people who work a short drive away.

reasons.title: A new ring road is planned
reasons.text: The Bengaluru Business Corridor (Peripheral Ring Road) is a 73 km road with a reported 2029 deadline, linking the Devanahalli side with the Sarjapur side.

upcoming.status: Open. 43.49 km, 37 stations; the Whitefield (Kadugodi) end opened on 26 March 2023.
upcoming.why: Whitefield already has a working metro across the city, and it meets the airport line at KR Pura.
upcoming.source: Wikipedia (Namma Metro line pages), read 26 Nov 2026

upcoming.status: Trial runs began November 2026. 38.44 km from KR Puram to the airport via Hebbal and Yelahanka. Overall construction was 72% in August 2026; completion is reported for December 2027.
upcoming.why: A metro within reach turns a car-only address into a commuter address.
upcoming.source: IANS, 11 Nov 2026; Business Today, 6 Aug 2026; Oneindia, 2026

upcoming.status: 73 km ring road with a reported 2029 deadline.
upcoming.why: Takes through-traffic off the Outer Ring Road and shortens cross-city trips.

timelineSource: Wikipedia (Namma Metro line pages), read 26 Nov 2026; IANS, 11 Nov 2026; Oneindia, 2026; Sattva Group market note, 2026. Government target dates can move.
band: Whitefield's metro is running today. That is the difference between a plan and an address that already works.
